title: PDF Agent Ecosystem Crosswalk

source_documents.filename: Zero-Budget AI Agent Ecosystem Map - 10 Unique 2026-10-28.pdf
source_documents.note: Role names and architecture are taken from the uploaded PDF; this file does not assert that every role is independently running.
The Researcher, Writer, and Editor workflow is represented by the Researcher, Writer, and Reviewer entries below.

budget_policy: No new dependencies, model API keys, paid APIs, subscriptions, or model downloads are introduced by this crosswalk.
framework_policy: CrewAI, LangGraph, ChromaDB, and hosted model endpoints are not installed or activated by this mapping.

status_policy.partial: Some related deterministic/read-only/draft functionality exists, but the PDF role is not implemented as a full independent model-backed agent.
status_policy.not_implemented: No adequate safe implementation of the named capability is currently mapped.

roles.current_behavior: The runtime routes a known task type to a registered handler; a specialist can map task dependencies. This is deterministic routing, not autonomous planning.
roles.gap: No general planner that converts arbitrary goals into validated multi-step plans.
roles.safe_next_step: Add a bounded plan schema and test it with offline fixtures before connecting workers.

roles.current_behavior: The mapped system does not claim to generate, patch, or execute arbitrary code.
roles.gap: No tested code-generation worker with sandboxing, syntax checks, diff limits, and regression tests.
roles.safe_next_step: Do not add arbitrary shell execution. If needed, propose code diffs only, then run offline tests in CI.

roles.current_behavior: Deterministic checks can flag annotation/evidence quality and review supplied inputs; they are not a general code-security auditor.
roles.gap: No broad static-analysis or security-review agent for arbitrary generated code.
roles.safe_next_step: Use existing deterministic checks plus Python compile/tests and vetted static-analysis tools when available.

roles.current_behavior: Existing hunters perform bounded research against configured public sources; the source-verifier specialist checks user-supplied evidence shape without fetching URLs.
roles.gap: No universal open-web research worker with guaranteed freshness or completeness.
roles.safe_next_step: Keep source URL, checked timestamp, quote/snippet and eligibility status attached to each lead; require human verification.

roles.current_behavior: The offline content pipeline creates captions, a seven-day calendar, short Reel scripts, spec-work concepts and unsent outreach drafts from supplied facts.
roles.gap: Deterministic templates are not equivalent to a connected model-backed writer and may need human rewriting.
roles.safe_next_step: Use existing output as a draft and fact-check all business claims before publishing.

roles.current_behavior: Structured opportunity and ledger data can be tracked and summarized; this does not promise sophisticated ML analysis.
roles.gap: No general-purpose natural-language data analyst or model-backed visualization agent is connected by this crosswalk.
roles.safe_next_step: Add reproducible CSV summary tests and display sample size, source and last-checked date.

roles.current_behavior: The system drafts customer-facing copy and permission-first outreach for human review; it does not send messages or run a sentiment-aware chat agent.
roles.gap: No live conversational channel or authorized message-sending integration.
roles.safe_next_step: Keep all communications as drafts unless the owner separately approves a connected, supported send action.

roles.current_behavior: The runtime dispatches bounded local tasks and writes a task event; approval-gate capabilities classify sensitive actions. It does not perform arbitrary shell commands or external account actions.
roles.safe_next_step: Maintain deny-by-default tool access and human approval for publishing, outreach, account changes, spend and payment actions.

roles.current_behavior: The branch contains a supervised, versioned learning/evaluation loop; this is not ChromaDB-backed semantic conversation memory.
roles.gap: No validated persistent vector store or privacy-reviewed retrieval policy is connected.
roles.safe_next_step: Do not add a vector database until storage, deletion, data-minimization and regression-test behavior are defined.

roles.current_behavior: A deterministic task runner and offline specialist pipeline coordinate bounded local capabilities. The LangGraph/CrewAI frameworks are not installed.
roles.gap: No distributed, model-backed graph orchestrator or dynamic agent-to-agent dialogue.
roles.safe_next_step: Use the current standard-library workflow first; adopt an external framework only after a tested requirement and verified no-cost deployment path exist.
